meta.title: Olimex ESP32-DevKit-LiPo · dead on USB, won't charge
meta.author: DEADBOARD
meta.description: A real, sold ESP32 board (50 parts) with a Li-ion charger. The owner says it stopped doing anything on USB after the cable got yanked, and before that the battery "never seemed to charge". No battery is plugged in on your bench. Bench supply: 5 V on /+5V_USB (rail name +5V_USB).
hints: Follow the USB 5 V in: measure the USB rail, then +5V after D1. A diode with volts on one side and nothing on the other is open, or not soldered.
With no battery fitted, a working charger holds its BAT pin near 4.2 V. If it reads 0 V, check the part that sets its charge current: the resistor on PROG (U1 pin 5).
Reflow what is cracked; fit what is missing (its value is printed in the Inspector).
